Failed load clears old list data; new request generations and cleanup invalidate old list/detail responses. Denied detail clears prior list data and supersedes pending list replies. No error path reports financial success.

Bilingual copy, RTL and bdi identifiers, SAR/Riyadh use existing components. Keyboard/mobile runtime acceptance is not asserted by this source-only pass.

Contract matches frozen SQL eligibility, projection, permission/grants, audit, bounds and same-statement snapshot limits. No production/shared migration/provider/native acceptance claim. Azure and all business approval holds are retained.
